He finished with over 400 total yards and two touchdowns, but he also threw two interceptions, one of which was returned for a touchdown. He made some mistakes that opened the door for Denver to win this game, but fantasy managers should be happy with his production and should continue to start him in favorable matchups moving forward.

He lost three turnovers over the course of the afternoon and was only able to lead the Patriots to six points in a blowout loss to the Jaguars.
